proposals.before: Emperor Taizong of Tang restored the ancient tradition and had Zu Xiaosun and Zhang Wenshou revise the court music, so that the eighty-four circulatory modes reappeared and no instrument in the bell-chime ensemble remained mute. The An Lushan rebellion left the capital in ruins; scarcely one instrument or craftsman in ten survived, and the music performed grew ever more corrupt.
proposals.after: Emperor Taizong of Tang restored the ancient tradition and had Zu Xiaosun and Zhang Wenshou revise the court music, so that the eighty-four circulatory modes reappeared and no instrument in the bell-chime ensemble remained mute. The An and Shi rebellion left the capital in ruins; scarcely one instrument or craftsman in ten survived, and the music performed grew ever more corrupt.
proposals.reason: Chinese 安、史之亂 names both An and Shi; idiomatic English collapses this to An Lushan alone.

proposals.before: After the An Lushan rebellion, the heartland was laid waste.
proposals.after: After the An and Shi rebellion, the heartland was laid waste.
proposals.reason: Chinese 安、史亂離 names both rebels; idiomatic English omits Shi.

proposals.before: Emperor Wu of Liang, himself expert in pitch theory, devised twelve four-way flutes to sound the eight categories of instruments.
proposals.after: Emperor Wu of Liang, himself expert in pitch theory, devised four sitong pitch-standards and twelve flutes to sound the eight categories of instruments.
proposals.reason: Chinese 四通十二笛 is four sitong devices plus twelve flutes, not twelve four-way flutes.

decisions.reason: s0054 has 安、史之亂, naming both An and Shi; the before text reduces this to An Lushan alone. The proposed "An and Shi rebellion" restores both names without other changes.
s0113 has 安、史亂離; the before text again names only An Lushan. "An and Shi rebellion" correctly reflects both rebels named in the Chinese.
s0103 自造四通十二笛 is four 通 (sitong pitch-standards) plus twelve flutes, not twelve "four-way" flutes. The proposed English correctly separates the two instrument types.
